extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: Video-MME is a full-spectrum, multi-modal evaluation benchmark designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in video analysis. It consists of 900 manually curated videos spanning 6 major visual domains and 30 subfields across short, medium, and long durations (11 seconds to 1 hour), accompanied by 2,700 expert-annotated multiple-choice question-answer pairs, subtitles, and audio tracks.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Videos were collected from YouTube based on a domain hierarchy of 6 key domains and 30 sub-categories across short (<2 minutes), medium (4-15 minutes), and long (30-60 minutes) durations, alongside corresponding subtitles and audio tracks.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: User-generated content data, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw video clips, subtitles, and audio tracks collected from YouTube.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Frames were uniformly extracted from videos according to model configurations (e.g., 1 frame per second for short/medium videos and 1 frame per 2 seconds for long videos for Gemini 1.5 Pro). In the subtitle-enabled setting, subtitles corresponding to the timestamps of sampled video frames were selected to ensure synchronization.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators thoroughly viewed entire videos and iteratively constructed three relevant multiple-choice questions per video with four candidate options across 12 distinct task types. QA pairs were designed to require video content as a critical clue.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair underwent manual cross-examination by a different annotator to check language clarity, question answerability, logical consistency of options, and correctness of answers. Text-only questions were evaluated using Gemini 1.5 Pro to filter out questions answerable without video context (yielding <15% accuracy); failing QA pairs were sent back to the original annotator for revision.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution of the options (A/B/C/D) follows a near-uniform distribution (25.1/27.2/25.3/22.4%) to ensure unbiased evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: A general decline in MLLM performance is observed as video duration increases due to increased task difficulty, sparsity in frame sampling, and difficulties in long context modeling. Counting problems represent a shared performance bottleneck across multimodal models.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and benchmarking of Multimodal Large Language Models (both image- and video-based MLLMs) on video comprehension across multiple temporal lengths and modalities.
